# Sapphire v1.0.9 - Examples

This document demonstrates the new syntax features introduced in Sapphire v1.0.9.

## 1. Arrow Functions

Arrow functions provide a concise syntax for defining functions.

```sapphire
var square = (x) => x * x;
print "Square of 5 is: " + square(5);

var add = (a, b) => a + b;
print "5 + 3 is: " + add(5, 3);
```

## 2. String Interpolation (f-strings)

Easily embed variables and expressions inside strings using `f"..."`.

```sapphire
var name = "Sapphire";
var version = "v1.0.9";
print f"Welcome to {name} {version}!";
```

## 3. Optional Chaining

Safely access nested properties without causing an error if an intermediate value is `nil`.

```sapphire
class User {
    var profile;
}
class Profile {
    var email;
}

var u = User();
print "User email (uninitialized): " + u?.profile?.email; // Safely returns nil instead of throwing
```

## 4. Nullish Coalescing

Provide a default value when the left side is `nil`.

```sapphire
var a = nil;
var b = "Default Value";
print "a ?? b is: " + (a ?? b); // Prints: Default Value
```

## 5. Array Spread Operator

Expand an array inside another array.

```sapphire
var arr1 = [1, 2, 3];
var arr2 = [...arr1, 4, 5];
print "Arr2[3]: " + arr2[3]; // Prints: 4
```

## 6. Array Destructuring

Unpack values from arrays into distinct variables.

```sapphire
var arr3 = [10, 20];
var [x, y] = arr3;
print "x: " + x; // Prints: 10
print "y: " + y; // Prints: 20
```

## 7. Shorthand Properties for Maps

Create map keys and values using variable names concisely.

```sapphire
var theme = "dark";
var fontSize = 14;
var config = { theme, fontSize };
print "config.theme: " + config["theme"]; // Prints: dark
```
